desc_en: Redefine your formal presence with this contemporary tailoring piece. Crafted with a distinctive graphic motif, this blazer offers a structured regular fit silhouette. It features traditional flat lapels and functional front pockets. A versatile garment designed to transition effortlessly between daytime commitments and exclusive evenings. Each piece is crafted to order to ensure exclusivity within our community. Available with worldwide shipping.

Presenta solapas planas tradicionales y bolsillos frontales funcionales. Una prenda versátil diseñada para la transición entre compromisos diurnos y veladas exclusivas. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda para garantizar la exclusividad dentro de nuestra comunidad. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
